backward_compat_traps.v1_to_v2_inclusive: VIL fixed 1.5 V, VIH fixed 3.0 V (legacy).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Mixing legacy (1.5/3.0 V fixed) devices on a 5 V bus with new ratiometric devices may cause input-level violations on the legacy device.

backward_compat_traps.pre_rev4: All I2C-bus devices were open-drain bidirectional.
backward_compat_traps.rev4_and_later: Ultra Fast-mode is push-pull unidirectional (write-only); not interoperable with bidirectional Sm/Fm/Fm+/Hs devices on the same physical bus.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Mixing UFm devices with bidirectional devices is forbidden — UFm bus is electrically a separate physical bus.
Over-loading the bus past per-mode Cb_max causes rise-time violations and CRC-equivalent data corruption.

fields.spec_version: TI TFP410 datasheet revision D (February 2024) — implements DVI 1.0 + HDMI video-only.
previous_versions: v1.0 (1992) — Original Philips I2C-bus spec; Standard-mode 100 kHz
v3.0 (2007) — Added Fast-mode Plus 1 MHz; clarified 10-bit addressing
Rev. 4 (2012) — Added Ultra Fast-mode (UFm) 5 Mbit/s push-pull unidirectional

key_changes.summary: Fast-mode (400 kbit/s) added; legacy fixed input levels (1.5/3.0 V) supplemented by 30%/70% VDD spec.
Fast-mode Plus (1 Mbit/s) introduced; Cb up to 550 pF allowed for Fm+.
Ultra Fast-mode (UFm) added — unidirectional, push-pull, 5 Mbit/s; no arbitration.
Editorial cleanup; clarified bus-clear procedure and Device ID read sequence.

fields.version_naming_history_note: TFP410 has shipped continuously since October 2001 across SLDS145 revisions A→D with no silicon revision; SLDS145D (February 2024) is the latest datasheet revision. DVI 1.0 (1999) and HDMI 1.0 video-only (2002) are the relevant protocol specifications. TFP410 does NOT support HDMI 1.3+ Deep Color, HDMI 1.4+ 3D / HEC / ARC, HDMI 2.x high-rate FRL, or any HDCP version (cipher outside chip). For modern HDMI 2.x / 2.1 designs use a current HDMI transmitter such as TI TMDS181, TMDS261, or similar.
